jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are Printed.com, one of the largest and fastest growing on\-line print shops in the UK. We are filled to the brim with a passionate team who are mad about printing, designing, building and growing the business. In the office you’ll find that we are forward\-thinking, with a mission to be creative, innovative and to help our customers.


We are constantly investing in new products and using technology to improve how we increase our market share and take advantage of new opportunities. Catch us in our production space and you will find a fast\-paced, dedicated team who endeavour to reach perfection for our customers.

  

We’re a growing company with offices in London and Newcastle, looking for employees that are equal parts dynamic and enthusiastic. People brimming over with new, original ideas that they just can’t wait to share with their team and bring to life.


We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team as we scale our platform across UK and US markets. Reporting our Technical Engineering Manager, you'll work across a mix of PHP (Symfony/Laravel) applications running on AWS (EC2 and EKS), contributing hands\-on to feature development and platform improvements. This role suits someone building their confidence owning well\-scoped problems, who's comfortable asking the right questions when something's unclear, and who's keen to develop their skills with support from senior engineers. You'll be trusted to make sound technical decisions within your area, execute reliably against a spec, and start contributing to the team's engineering practices as you grow into a more senior role.


This is a hybrid role with a minimum of 2 days required in our Cramlington office.

 **Requirements**  

Ownership \& Initiative


Take ownership of well\-defined problems and features, escalating ambiguity or unclear requirements to a Senior Engineer or Manager rather than resolving it unsupported. Comfortable digging into a bug beyond the surface symptom, with support available when the root cause isn't obvious.

  

Multi\-Project Delivery


Work across a small number of concurrent workstreams — typically feature development alongside platform or infrastructure tasks — managing your own time and flagging early when priorities conflict, rather than resolving trade\-offs independently.

  

Engineering Best Practices


Follow and reinforce engineering best practices (code review standards, testing, CI/CD, documentation) consistently in your own work and give constructive code review feedback to peers and junior engineers.

  

Process \& Ways\-of\-Working Adoption


Adopt new tools, processes, and ways of working as the engineering function matures, and help surface friction or confusion you hit along the way so it can be fed back to the team leads driving the change.

  

Mentoring \& Technical Guidance


Support junior engineers through pairing and code review and be receptive to mentoring and technical guidance from senior engineers as you build toward more autonomous ownership.

**Key Skills**

* Our stack is PHP (Symfony/Laravel) with Vue.js front ends \- but we're open to engineers from other frameworks (e.g. Rails, Django, .NET) or other JS frameworks (React, Angular) who can demonstrate solid fundamentals and pick things up quickly
* Comfortable working across JavaScript, SCSS, and Twig as part of day\-to\-day full\-stack delivery, or building toward that across a similar front\-to\-back stack
* Working knowledge of AWS (EC2, EKS/containers, RDS, or similar services), or strong general cloud fundamentals with willingness to build AWS\-specific depth
* Good exposure to DevOps, platform, or infrastructure work
* Comfortable managing your own priorities across a small number of concurrent tasks
* Clear, confident communicator, comfortable asking questions and flagging blockers rather than guessing
* Open to pairing with and learning from other engineers; some experience supporting junior engineers or interns is a plus
* Familiarity with observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir) is a plus
* Developing a pragmatic sense of trade\-offs between speed, technical debt, and long\-term maintainability
* A proactive problem\-solver \- comfortable taking a well\-defined problem and running with it, and knowing when to ask for direction on the ambiguous parts
* Approaches technical disagreement collaboratively \- pushes back on ideas, not people, and is open to being persuaded by a stronger argument
* Beginning to factor cost into technical decisions, with guidance from senior engineers on the bigger architectural calls
* Some exposure to legacy or end\-of\-life systems is useful, though not expected to lead modernisation efforts independently
* Security\-conscious in day\-to\-day development (access control, dependency hygiene, data handling), with senior engineers available for the trickier calls

 **Benefits**  

* 25 days holiday Plus 8 days bank holidays
* Staff discounts \& Friends and Family discounts
* Cycle to work scheme, Tech Scheme and EV Scheme (subject to conditions)
* Breakfast and drinks provided on days you work in the office
* 1 Charity Day per year
* Summer and Christmas Parties
* Street food days
* Perkbox membership
* Enhanced parental leave
* Staff discount on print

About Parkster

At Parkster, we want to be the best at what we do. We build smart, user-friendly software, strive for top-tier customer service, and strive to be a fantastic employer. We have offices in Lund and Munich, and our services are live in around 1,400 locations across Sweden, Germany, and Austria, used by hundreds of thousands of people every day.

Our engineering team currently counts just over 20 people. Many of us have years of experience, but nobody has lost the drive to solve tough problems and learn new things together.

We have just launched a brand-new team dedicated entirely to our product integrations. These are the connections we build or configure alongside our customers and partners. Some of the most common examples are automatic license plate recognition (ANPR) cameras, EV charging, and data/statistics collection.

Initially, the team's hands-on focus will be building the integrations needed right now. Long-term, the goal is to empower others to quickly and easily configure standard integrations on their own, without needing to involve developers.

The same applies to monitoring the health of our existing integrations. To start with, you will dive in to investigate and resolve ongoing issues. We have already started visualizing this data and will set up smart alerting so that the right information reaches the right person at the right time. It’s going to be an exciting journey!

We are looking for a Junior Fullstack Developer with a solid technical foundation, high drive, and a good commercial mindset to join this team.

We are based out of our Lund office and truly value the sense of community at our workplace. While you have the flexibility to work from home a day or two a week, we hope you appreciate face-to-face collaboration and casual chats by the coffee machine just as much as we do!

Who Are You?

To thrive in this role, we believe you are someone who:

Has a solid technical foundation. Our systems are large and complex. To get up to speed, you need a broad technical baseline and a genuine desire to understand how things work under the hood. An appropriate foundation is either a masters in a related field, and/or at least two years of working experience as a developer.
Enjoys working with both people and machines. Integrations always involve another party, so it matters that you enjoy meeting potential customers and partners, both in person and online, and that you don't mind picking up the phone to get an answer or push an implementation forward.
Focuses on business value and user impact. We love building top-class technical solutions, but we always prioritize what creates the most value. The ability to evaluate, prioritize, and adjust your focus is crucial.
Is always curious to learn. You happily share your knowledge and actively seek feedback from your peers to keep growing.
You speak German and English (Swedish is a plus too!). What We Work With

We don't hold any prestige when it comes to specific programming languages, we simply choose the best tool for the job. Today, our daily life looks roughly like this:

Backend: Java and Kotlin with Spring Boot.
Frontend: TypeScript, React, and Next.js (we also have Web Components and some legacy JSP).
Platform/Infrastructure: Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Databases: BigQuery, MongoDB, and MySQL, among others.

If you already know this stack, or if you have the drive and sharpness to pick it up quickly, you’ll love it here.

What We Offer

We are a team driven by building software that makes a real difference. Today, we are over a hundred colleagues across our offices in Sweden and Germany, enjoying close collaboration and a great community across borders and departments.

As an international growth company, we offer a fast-paced environment with plenty of room to grow. Here, you become part of a forward-thinking organization with short decision-making paths and a flat, ego-free culture.

Parkster offers great benefits, including an occupational pension, health insurance, a wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag), and above all, a workplace where we have serious fun at work.

Sounds like a match?

We recruit continuously and look forward to hearing from you. Send us your CV and a cover letter telling us a bit about what drives you.

Please note: Since it’s summertime, our response times might be a bit slower than usual over the holidays. We’ll be back in full force starting August 10th, and we appreciate your patience in the meantime!
